main.description: Resolve or escalate a subject, optionally with a note. Repeating the current status adds the note. Requires mod.resolve: a member's service auth, or a group-DID session with this method's rpc: scope, whose member holds it at each call.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject isn't an account, a record in this group, or a record in a public repo.

errors.name: SubjectNotFound
errors.description: The subject has never been reported.
